name: BrightHR
description_en:
BrightHR combines employee records, leave, rotas, attendance and related people-management tools with optional HR advice and broader support packages. This review covers the UK website and its Core, Enhanced and Full pricing presentation.

Its leave planner routes employee requests to a manager and flags clashes; the Blip attendance app captures clock events using geofences, QR codes or workplace computers. These operational records can support payroll preparation, but a timesheet or payroll report alone does not establish that a payroll service is included.
description_zh:
BrightHR 将员工档案、休假、排班、考勤等人员管理工具与可选的 HR 咨询和其他支持套餐组合。本档案依据英国官网及其 Core、Enhanced、Full 价格展示研究。

休假规划工具把员工申请交给经理并提示冲突；Blip 考勤应用支持地理围栏、二维码及工作电脑打卡。这些运营记录可用于工资准备，但工时表或工资报表本身不能证明套餐已包含工资处理服务。

core_features.explanation_en: Employees request leave; managers receive notifications, see clashes and approve or decline.
core_features.explanation_zh: 员工申请休假，经理接收通知、查看冲突并批准或拒绝。

core_features.explanation_en: Staff can use QR codes, geofences or computers; managers can review adjustment requests and record retrospective entries.
core_features.explanation_zh: 员工可通过二维码、地理围栏或电脑打卡；经理可审核调整申请并补录记录。

core_features.explanation_en: Enhanced adds HR advice to Core; the fuller bundle adds health-and-safety and employee assistance services.
core_features.explanation_zh: Enhanced 在 Core 基础上增加 HR 咨询，更完整的组合增加健康安全及员工援助服务。

pricing.summary_en: UK paid packages; employee-count calculator and fixed 24/36/60-month contracts, online purchase 36 months. Tax, insurance and payroll scope require confirmation.
pricing.summary_zh: 英国收费套餐采用人数计算器和 24/36/60 个月固定期限，线上购买为 36 个月；税、保险及工资服务范围需确认。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: A request is not an approved absence
sections.title_zh: 休假申请不等于已获批准
sections.en: The documented holiday flow is explicit: an employee submits a request, the manager receives a notification, BrightHR flags clashes, and the manager accepts or declines. For example, two colleagues requesting the same busy Friday would create a coverage decision for the manager; the alert does not itself decide staffing. Automatic allowance calculations and a shared calendar depend on correct employee patterns and policies. The planner is part of BrightHR HR software, rather than a separately purchasable holiday-only product according to its FAQ.
sections.zh: 官方明确给出休假流程：员工提交申请、经理收到通知、系统提示冲突、经理批准或拒绝。例如两名同事同时申请繁忙周五休假时，经理仍需决定人员覆盖，提醒本身不会自动作出排班决定。自动额度计算和共享日历依赖正确的工作模式及政策设置。FAQ 说明休假规划工具属于 BrightHR HR 软件，不能作为独立的单一休假产品购买。

sections.title_en: Choose a clocking method and handle missed punches
sections.title_zh: 选择打卡方式并处理漏卡
sections.en: Blip offers QR codes displayed at a workplace, GPS geofences and clocking from work computers for staff without a personal smartphone. The product page describes reminders and approval or rejection of clock adjustment requests, as well as retrospective manager entries. A useful pilot would include a missed clock-out: capture the explanation, review the correction and compare planned versus actual hours before exporting the report. This is a suggested test, not proof of an audit-history feature. GPS prompting and clock events should not be interpreted as independently verified continuous location monitoring.
sections.zh: Blip 支持工作场所展示二维码、GPS 地理围栏，以及让没有个人智能手机的员工从工作电脑打卡。官方说明提供提醒、打卡调整申请的批准或拒绝，以及经理补录。试运行可覆盖一次下班漏卡：收集说明、审核更正，再比较计划与实际工时并导出报表。这是建议测试，不代表已验证审计历史功能。GPS 提醒及打卡事件也不应被扩大为已独立核实的持续位置监控。

sections.title_en: Buy the support level your business needs
sections.en: Core lists HR records, leave and absence, rotas, performance, overtime and a payroll navigator alongside time and expense apps. Enhanced adds 24/7 HR and employment advice and document support. The fuller package combines HR with health-and-safety and employee assistance services. The page separately links payroll software, so buyers should specify whether they need reports, a payroll product or a managed service. UK legal-support claims are vendor service descriptions, not a guarantee of compliance. Other regional sites have separate offerings and should not inherit the UK terms.
sections.zh: Core 列出 HR 档案、休假缺勤、排班、绩效、加班、工资准备导航及工时费用应用。Enhanced 增加全天候 HR 和雇佣咨询及文档支持；更完整的套餐组合健康安全及员工援助服务。页面单独链接工资软件，因此购买时应明确需要的是报表、工资产品还是代管服务。英国法律支持是供应商的服务描述，不等于合规保证；其他地区网站的产品和条款也不能直接沿用英国版本。

sections.title_en: Monthly figures sit inside fixed-term contracts
sections.title_zh: 月度金额对应固定期限合同
sections.en: The captured calculator displays Core from £16.67 per employee per month and £83.35 monthly total excluding tax, Enhanced £21.20 and £106, and Full £31.30 and £156.50. Its selected employee count was not independently established, so these are displayed examples rather than universal rates. The FAQ also advertises pricing from £3 per person depending on business size. BrightHR lists 24-, 36- and 60-month fixed terms, with online purchases on 36 months. A monthly amount therefore does not mean monthly cancellation. Online prices exclude insurance; confirm headcount, included services, tax, insurance and termination terms in a written quote. Free demos and separate free tools are not evidence of a sustained free full HR plan.
sections.zh: 读取到的计算器显示 Core 每员工每月起价 16.67 英镑、未税月总额 83.35 英镑；Enhanced 分别为 21.20 和 106 英镑；Full 为 31.30 和 156.50 英镑。未独立确认其所选员工人数，故这些仅是当前展示示例，不是通用费率。FAQ 另称按企业规模可低至每人 3 英镑。BrightHR 列出 24、36、60 个月固定期限，线上购买为 36 个月。因此月度金额不等于可以逐月取消。线上价格不含保险，应以书面报价确认人数、服务、税、保险及终止条件。免费演示和单独的免费工具也不能证明完整 HR 套餐可长期免费使用。

sections.title_en: Validate policy settings before payroll use
sections.title_zh: 用于工资前先验证政策设置
sections.en: BrightHR is a plausible fit for a UK employer centralizing leave, rotas and attendance while choosing an advice package. A team needing only a standalone holiday tool should account for the bundled scope and contract duration. Prepare employee working patterns, holiday years, approval owners and clocking access, then check part-time balances, denied leave, missed punches and report totals in a pilot. Neither a legal review nor a live account test was performed here. Data migration, retention, hosting, full exports, payroll connectors and correction audit details remain procurement questions. The reviewed pages do not establish a self-hosted edition or open-source license.
sections.zh: 对于希望集中管理休假、排班、考勤并选择咨询支持的英国雇主，BrightHR 值得评估。只需独立休假工具的团队，应考虑其组合范围和合同长度。先准备工作模式、休假年度、审批负责人和打卡方式，再在试运行中检查兼职余额、拒批休假、漏卡及报表合计。本研究未开展法律审查或实际账户测试；迁移、保留期限、托管、完整导出、工资连接器及更正审计细节仍需采购核实。所读页面未确立自托管版本或开源许可。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Calculator headcount state, an actual quote and the signed contract were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实计算器人数状态、实际报价及签署合同。

research_gaps.en: No attendance, GPS, permission, payroll or export workflow was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际执行考勤、GPS、权限、工资或导出流程。
